objective: Deliver the branch feat/playbook-merge so labdrian-sdd-overlay carries the playbook wiki and agents (snapshot 6de8566, v3.6.0, MIT) as one tool with the overlay's roles, learning loop first, per odd/tasks/merge-playbook-into-sdd-overlay.md.
scope: The specs S1-S15 of odd/tasks/merge-playbook-into-sdd-overlay.md; tasks T1-T18 in the document's execution order, the learning loop (T1-T6, T16, T17) first, each task blocked by an open decision waiting for the owner's answer.
constraints: No new standalone repository; every imported playbook capability is listed in overlay.manifest.
The dev checkout ~/labdrian-sdd-overlay is never written; work happens in ~/labdrian-sdd-overlay-playbook-merge.
Commits use Conventional Commits with no AI attribution or Co-Authored-By.
Push, pull request and merge happen only on the owner's explicit decision.
Persisted artifacts hold no persona text.
No merged artifact names Engram as a write target; memorycard is the one memory store.
Absorbed playbook code carries the MIT LICENSE notice and a provenance note naming snapshot 6de8566 from the first commit that absorbs it.
Nothing is consolidated or promoted in the evidence loop without the owner's answer or a delegation the owner gave.
A task blocked by an open decision is not built until the owner answers it.
non_goals: Upstream tracking or a vendor branch for the playbook.
Replay or backtest of a rule on past reviews, rule retirement, rule pinning, scoring, and parallel candidate generation.
Any number from arXiv 2611.18856 or 2611.23476 as an acceptance criterion.
acceptance_criteria: Each task of odd/tasks/merge-playbook-into-sdd-overlay.md that is built is checked off with its commits.
A stored review result with kept findings yields Evidence rows on docs/wiki/evidence.md once, and a result with no kept finding is never asked about.
With no level-2+ kind, rule injection adds no text to the builder or reviewer prompt; with one, the index reaches both.
After a consolidation, the history of the kind holds the replaced rule, its period and its review identifiers.
gadu-generate --check is green in CI with the classifier and explorer agents generated.
No merged artifact names Engram as a write target, and the MIT notice and provenance note are present from the first commit that absorbs playbook content.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, as the parent that runs the labdrian workflow and the role agents; other runtime targets wait on OD-7.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on feat/playbook-merge in ~/labdrian-sdd-overlay-playbook-merge; push, pull requests and merges remain the owner's explicit decisions.
